run_test_subprocess: run a subprocess command and capture stdout and stderr output with exit code
get_test_executable_path: get the absolute path of a test binary by name from the build directory
set_env_var: set or unset an environment variable to a given value in the test environment
get_exit_status: extract the exit status code from the result of os.system command
get_temp_dir: get a temporary directory path for storing test files that is cleaned up on exit
